title: nf-core/dartseq pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline for m6A detection in RNAseq data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/dartseq/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

skip_alignment.description: Skip alignment stage (useful for smoke tests).

skip_bullseye.description: Skip Bullseye downstream stage on aligned BAM files.

bullseye_mock.description: Run Bullseye in mock mode without invoking Perl scripts.

annotation_reFlat_file.description: Annotation file for Find_edit_sites.pl (refFlat or compatible).

bullseye_control_group.description: Sample group label to use as control when pairing matrices for Bullseye (legacy mode, use bullseye_contrasts for explicit control).

bullseye_contrasts.description: Path to CSV file defining specific Bullseye comparisons with per-contrast parameters. When provided, overrides bullseye_control_group. See assets/contrasts.csv for format.

bullseye_edit_type.description: Conversion type for Find_edit_site.pl (for example C2U).

bullseye_edit_fold_threshold.description: Minimum edit fold threshold over control for Find_edit_site.pl.

bullseye_min_edit_sites.description: Minimum number of edits to report a site.

bullseye_edited_min_coverage.description: Minimum edited matrix coverage for Find_edit_site.pl.

bullseye_control_min_coverage.description: Minimum control matrix coverage for Find_edit_site.pl.

bullseye_replicates_min.description: Minimum replicate count used by summarize_sites.pl.

bullseye_min_mut.description: Minimum number of mutations (edits) required at a site, summed across replicates, to keep it in summarize_sites.pl (--mut).

skip_bullseye_racfilter.description: Skip RAC motif filtering on Bullseye quantified BED files.
skip_bullseye_racfilter.help_text: This only controls the strict canonical RAC motif requirement (a purine two bases upstream of the edited C). It has no effect on skip_bullseye_acfilter, which separately controls the AC motif check immediately upstream of it.

skip_bullseye_acfilter.description: Propagate every candidate edited site downstream instead of only the strict canonical AC-motif subset.
skip_bullseye_acfilter.help_text: BULLSEYE_ACFILTER always runs and always produces its AC.counts.tsv/all_sites*.bed diagnostics either way. This only controls which of its outputs (AC.bed, the strict subset, or all_sites.bed, every candidate site) propagates to downstream steps (RAC filtering, gathering, GLM). It's not yet confirmed whether APOBEC1-YTH edits occur only in the canonical A-before-C context, so set this if you want to keep non-canonical sites downstream.

bullseye_rac_remove_seq.description: If true, remove RAC sequence column from RAC-filtered output BED.

skip_bullseye_gather_sites.description: Skip aggregating Bullseye site-level outputs across samples using gather_scores.pl.

bullseye_gather_score.description: Request score matrix output from gather_sites.pl.

bullseye_gather_coverage.description: Request coverage matrix output from gather_sites.pl.

bullseye_gather_mutations.description: Request mutation-count matrix output from gather_sites.pl.

skip_bullseye_glm.description: Skip Bullseye R GLM helper on gathered coverage and mutation tables.

bullseye_glm_mock.description: Run Bullseye GLM module in mock mode.

bullseye_functions_r_file.description: Path to functions.R used by the Bullseye GLM helper.

bullseye_glm_observations.description: Path to a tab-delimited observations file containing sample metadata with at least a 'sample' column (consistent with nf-core/differentialabundance).

bullseye_glm_coverage.description: Start from matrices: tab-delimited per-site coverage matrix (BULLSEYE_GATHER_SITES format: #chr, start, end, cluster, strand, then one column per sample). Requires --bullseye_glm_mut and --bullseye_glm_observations; skips FASTQ processing, alignment and Bullseye site calling, so --input is not needed.

bullseye_glm_mut.description: Start from matrices: tab-delimited per-site mutation-count matrix matching --bullseye_glm_coverage (same rows and sample columns).

bullseye_glm_design.description: R formula string used as design in Bullseye GLM helper.

bullseye_glm_link.description: Link/model option passed to Bullseye helper function.

bullseye_glm_min_cov.description: Minimum coverage threshold passed to Bullseye GLM helper.

star_ignore_sjdbgtf.description: When using pre-built STAR index, do not pass the GTF file at the mapping step.

hisat2_splicesites.description: Path to HISAT2 splice sites file.

hisat2_build_memory.description: Minimum memory threshold for HISAT2 index build to include splice-site/exon hints.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

test_root.description: Root directory for test data and caches. Defaults to DARTSEQ_TEST_ROOT environment variable.
